key_points: Nvidia scandal could pressure one of SPY’s biggest constituents, but impact likely limited to a few percent of the ETF
ETFs added Apple and Nvidia holdings worth $4.32 bn, providing a modest lift to SPY
Broad ETF buying of semiconductor names (AMD, Micron, Intel, etc.) signals sector flow that may offset Nvidia downside
Overall effect on SPY price is expected to be low‑volatility and short‑term, more noise than thesis‑changing
Maintain current positioning; monitor Nvidia earnings and any regulatory developments for potential upside/downside
